name: NC Wholesale - Deal Creation & Disposition Handoff

parameters.jsCode: const req=$('Deal Handoff Webhook').first().json.body||$('Deal Handoff Webhook').first().json; const lead=$('Get Lead').first().json; const rawDeals=$('Get Existing Deals').first().json; const deals=Array.isArray(rawDeals)?rawDeals:(rawDeals.data||rawDeals.deals||[]); const cf=lead.custom_fields||{}; const readiness=cf.nc_wholesale_readiness||{}; const property=lead.property||{}; const offer=readiness.offer_inputs||{}; const leadId=Number(lead.id||req.lead_id||0); const existing=deals.find(d=>Number(d.lead_id)===leadId&&['closed_won','closed_lost'].indexOf(d.stage)<0); const guard={dnc:Boolean(lead.do_not_contact),offer_ready:Boolean(readiness.offer_ready),hasAddress:Boolean(property.address),hasPrice:Number(offer.asking_price||0)>0,hasArv:Number(offer.arv||0)>0}; const blocked=Object.values(guard).some(v=>!v); const buyerType=String(req.buyer_type||'individual').toLowerCase(); const buyerLegalName=String(req.buyer_legal_name||lead.full_name||'').trim(); const allowedBuyerTypes=['individual','entity']; const deal={title:(buyerLegalName||'Buyer')+' Wholesale Deal',stage:'offer_presented',contract_price:Number(offer.asking_price||0),assignment_fee:0,notes:'Wholesale opportunity. Contract structure must use an attorney-approved template for the applicable state.'}; return [{json:{lead_id:leadId,existing_deal_id:existing?.id||null,blocked,guard,deal,readiness,property,request:req,buyer_type:allowedBuyerTypes.includes(buyerType)?buyerType:'individual',buyer_legal_name:buyerLegalName}}];
